user.title: Turf Manager site
user.description: Choose where temperatures come from. A local weather station (e.g. Ecowitt) is best; use a BOM sensor as the fallback.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Outdoor air temperature. It needs a state class of 'measurement' so Home Assistant keeps long-term statistics (Ecowitt and BOM sensors do).
data_description.fallback_temperature_sensor: Used for any day the main sensor has less than 18 hours of data.
data_description.weather_entity: Used to project the next PGR due date.
data_description.gdd_method: Daily mean uses every reading through the day and is the most accurate.
data_description.season_start_month: Seasonal totals such as nitrogen applied reset on the 1st of this month.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Recorded with each application (spray records).
data_description.wind_sensor: Optional. Recorded with each application (spray records).
data_description.rain_sensor: Optional. Recorded with each application (spray records).

user.title: Add a product
user.description: Start from a preset or a blank product. Presets don't include rates: always use the label rate for your turf and region.

data_description.n_percent: Percent by weight, from the label analysis. Used for the seasonal nitrogen total.
data_description.density: Used to convert liquid rates to weight for nutrient totals. Defaults to 1.0.
data_description.gdd_interval: PGRs only. Choosing this product for a lawn sets its GDD target to this.
data_description.pgr_model: PGRs only. Enables the relative growth sensor (UNL model).
data_description.moa_group: Herbicide or fungicide group (e.g. HRAC 'B'), so you can rotate modes of action.

error.name_exists: A product with this name already exists.

options.minmax: Average of daily min and max
options.minmax_floor: Min/max with the low floored at the base (UNL Hi-Lo)

log_pgr_application.name: Log PGR application
log_pgr_application.description: Logs a plant growth regulator application and restarts the GDD count.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: When it was applied, if you want the time recorded.

product.name: Product
product.description: PGR product name. Defaults to the lawn's PGR product.

rate.name: Rate
rate.description: Rate in the product's unit. Defaults to the product's default rate.

log_application.name: Log application
log_application.description: Logs a product application, or several products applied together (a mix).

product.name: Product
product.description: Product name from your product library. Use this or Products.

rate.name: Rate
rate.description: Defaults to the product's default rate.

rate_unit.name: Rate unit
rate_unit.description: Defaults to the product's rate unit.

area.name: Area
area.description: Area treated. Defaults to the lawn's area.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: When it was applied, if you want the time recorded.

products.name: Products (mix)
products.description: For several products applied together: a list of product names with optional rate and rate_unit, e.g. [{product: Lawn food, rate: 2.5}, {product: Primo Maxx, rate: 4}].

log_mow.name: Log mow
log_mow.description: Logs a mow with the mower type and cut height.

height_unit.name: Height unit
height_unit.description: Unit of the cut height. Defaults to the site's setting.

clippings.name: Clippings
clippings.description: Clipping volume in litres. Tracking this is the best way to fine-tune the PGR GDD target.

log_activity.name: Log activity
log_activity.description: Logs a lawn care activity such as scarifying, coring or top dressing.

details.name: Details
details.description: Short details, e.g. '5 mm sand' or '50 mm spacing'.

update_entry.name: Update log entry
update_entry.description: Changes a logged entry. Entry ids are shown in calendar event details and returned by Get history.

height_unit.name: Height unit
height_unit.description: Unit of the new cut height.

delete_entry.name: Delete log entry
delete_entry.description: Deletes a logged entry. You can also delete events from the lawn's calendar.

set_daily_temperature.name: Set daily temperature
set_daily_temperature.description: Enters a day's temperature by hand, replacing sensor data for that day.

config_entry_id.name: Site
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one site.

recalculate.name: Recalculate temperatures
recalculate.description: Fetches daily temperatures again (e.g. after changing sensors). Manually entered days are kept.

config_entry_id.name: Site
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one site.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Defaults to 30 days before the end date.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns logged entries, and optionally daily GDD, for scripts, templates and dashboards.

kind.name: Kind

include_gdd.name: Include daily GDD

export_csv.name: Export to CSV

config_entry_id.name: Site
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one site.

mix_add.description: Adds a product to the lawn's mix on the dashboard. The next Log application logs the whole mix as one application.

mix_remove.name: Remove from mix

no_statistics.title: Temperature sensor has no long-term statistics
no_statistics.description: Turf Manager reads daily temperatures from long-term statistics, but {entity_id} doesn't have a state class of 'measurement'. Only about the last 10 days of history can be used, so back-dated PGR applications may be missing temperatures. Choose a different sensor, or set the sensor's state class to 'measurement' (for example with a template sensor).
